description: A comprehensive morphological analysis of traditional Bodrum house facades, focusing on the consistency of architectural elements (jambs, frames, materials).
research_question: How do the dimensions, materials, and bounding box properties of Bodrum traditional house facade elements vary spatially, and what is the statistical distribution of frame-to-jamb ratios across different geographical coordinates?

ethics_and_methodology.data_collection: Manual annotation and on-site field documentation.
ethics_and_methodology.data_reliability: Manual validation and coordinate cross-referencing performed.
